headers.comment: Astro fingerprints everything under /_astro, so it can be cached forever. A new build produces new filenames.

The page must never be cached, or a deploy would not reach anyone already holding a copy. Matched on the REQUEST path, so '/' and '/index.html' both need covering: a rule for '/index.html' alone left the site serving max-age=3600, verified against the live deploy.
robots and sitemap change rarely but should not be pinned for an hour.
